channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Wallace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Wallace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace
item.description:
Al Jefferson:

“That was Doc Rivers’ first year. Let me tell you what happened. This was in May, right? I’m flying to Boston for my first NBA workout, and I have no idea what to expect. Now, it’s 90 degrees in Mississippi, so I’m wearing a Paul Pierce jersey with the sleeves cut off and some shorts. I show up in Boston, and it’s cold as hell. Chris Wallace, the GM, had just bought a new car and lost it in the airport parking lot. We walked around for 45 minutes trying to find his car. Finally, we had to call for one of those airport carts to drive us around until we found it.”

Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace, Dec 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyreke Evans on Chris Wallace
item.description:
Evans told Grind City Media.

“You understand that as a player, and you just continue to do the best you can do and wait for everything else to play out. I talked to Chris (Wallace) and he told me what the situation was, and that he was happy with everything I was able to come here and try to do. All I know is that if I have to move on, I’m going to end up on a team that’s going to the playoffs and I’ll have a chance to contribute, hopefully the way I have here.”

Tyreke Evans on Chris Wallace, Feb 2, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Robert Pera on Chris Wallace
item.description:
“I am pleased to announce that our Basketball Operations executive team, led by General Manager, Chris Wallace, will continue to lead our franchise for years to come,”

Robert Pera on Chris Wallace, Dec 8, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Chris Wallace
item.description:
Chandler Parsons:

“Being the first big-name free agent to come here, I think that's special. I want to be a trendsetter. I'm going to work extremely hard to be the best basketball player I can be, butnext summer, you best believe I'm going to be with [GM Chris Wallace] recruiting more talent to Memphis.”

Chandler Parsons on Chris Wallace, Jul 8, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Chris Wallace
item.description:
He played in five preseason games before getting cut -- again, no surprise, given Memphis's roster, with Marc Gasol an All-Star incumbent at center, Zach Randolph newly extended and Kosta Koufos set as the backup big man.

“Chris Wallace (the Grizzlies' GM) told me to just go down and dominate the D-League, and I thought I could, too,”

Hassan Whiteside on Chris Wallace, Mar 9, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Robert Pera on Chris Wallace
item.description:
Wallace had acted as interim general manager since May 19, 2014.

“We are very pleased to announce Chris Wallace as our general manager,”

Robert Pera on Chris Wallace, Jul 29, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jerry West on Chris Wallace
item.description:
“Chris Wallace is from West Virginia (like West), but listen, I have nothing to do with anything going on up (in Sacramento),”

Jerry West on Chris Wallace, Jun 3, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jason Levien on Chris Wallace
item.description:
Levien reiterated during the public press conference that there are no current plans to replace any of the organization's top decision makers, instead suggesting that he and Pera's team would be evaluating what's already in place.

“I know Chris [Wallace] and I have a lot of respect for Chris. I'm looking forward to sitting down with them in this process,”

Jason Levien on Chris Wallace, Nov 5, 2012. Source: Memphis Flyer.
